what_happened: Task 436's state.json title field still reads the pre-revision '/orient command + retire /review' shape, but a same-day commit (5fd2899cc) rewrote the description to the opposite shape (extend /review in place, no new command). Caught via git show on the revision commit before planning could misread the stale title as authoritative.

Dispatch FILE SCOPE lists only the new agent file, commands/review.md, manifest.json, and index-entries.json as edit targets, but lint-agent-contracts.sh's Check F (EXCLUDED_ARTIFACTS_TEMPLATE_RELATIVE_PATHS) and Check J (CHECK_J_EXCLUDED_RELATIVE_PATHS) will both FAIL for the new console-only, forked-dispatch-only agent unless scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh itself is also edited to add it to both curated exclusion arrays -- a file not named in FILE SCOPE but required for the 'lint and validate scripts pass' ACCEPTANCE bullet.
